name: GGUF Q5_K_M (5-bit K-quant, medium)
bits: 5.7036 measured avg (llama.cpp quantize README, Llama-3.1-8B); pure block_q5_K is 5.5 bpw
quality_delta: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (quant-gguf-kquant-study): WikiText-2 ppl 7.40 vs 7.32 F16 (+0.08); GSM8K 64.35 vs 77.63 (-13.28, the study's clearest multi-step-reasoning regression among the 5-bit tier); IFEval 72.33 vs 78.93; unweighted mean 69.36 vs 69.47; size 5460 MiB (-64.35%).
notes: CORRECTED 2026-10-04: was 256. Base type Q5_K has a 32-value scale group: dequantize_row_q5_K uses the identical `j += 64` / two-get_scale_min_k4 structure as Q4_K, adding only the high-bit plane qh[]. 8 sub-blocks of 32 per super-block. Every K-quant shares the same super-block shape: QK_K = 256 values per block (ggml/src/ggml-common.h, `#define QK_K 256`), with K_SCALE_SIZE = 12 bytes of packed sub-block scales. block_q5_K = { ggml_half d; ggml_half dmin; uint8_t scales[K_SCALE_SIZE];  // 8+8 sub-block scales/mins at 6 bits uint8_t qh[QK_K/8];   // 32 bytes: the HIGH (5th) bit of each quant, 8 quants per byte uint8_t qs[QK_K/2]; }.  This is the same 4-bit-style split-bit trick as q5_0 and legacy q4_1/q5_1: qs holds the low 4 bits of each 5-bit quant (128 bytes), qh the 5th bit (32 bytes). 4+12+32+128 = 176 bytes / 256 values = 5.5 bpw, matching the header comment. 8 sub-blocks of 32, x = a*q + b. Q5_K_M IS A MIXTURE. From src/llama-quant.cpp: base q5_K; attn_v -> Q6_K when use_more_bits(i_attention_wv,n) (same predicate as Q4_K_M); ffn_down -> Q6_K when use_more_bits(i_layer,n_layer). That is the ONLY promotion - Q5_K_M does not touch attn_output, which is why it is only 0.06 bpw wider than pure q5_K (5.7036 vs 5.5) while Q4_K_M is 0.39 bpw wider than pure q4_K. The plain 'Q5_K' CLI name is an ALIAS for Q5_K_M. Q5_K_S promotes nothing and measures 5.5704 bpw - essentially pure q5_K. Also note llama-quant.cpp forces the OUTPUT tensor (and tied token embeddings) to Q6_K for most ftypes and to Q5_K for the i-quants, unless --output-tensor-type overrides it, and to Q8_0 when the row length is not a multiple of the block size (nx % qk_k != 0) or for Falcon. That is why 'Q5_K_M' is never a single type in the file. Weight-only: activations stay FP16/BF16 at runtime. Per-backend dequant+gemm; no silicon k-quant path. The official quantize tool reports Q5_K_M at +0.0569 ppl on Llama-3-8B and Q5_K_S at +0.1049, Q6_K at +0.0217 and Q8_0 at +0.0026 (qlab2-quantize-options-table).
